summary: 重要な比較・判断は単発runではなくtaskごとに複数trial（pass@k / pass^k）を取り、標準誤差・paired差分・transcript監査つきで読む。

evidence.summary: Anthropic: agent結果はrun間で変動し、pass@k（k回中1回成功）とpass^k（k回全成功）を用途で使い分ける。'each task has its own success rate' 'You won't know if your graders are working well unless you read the transcripts'。tracked_metricsにn_turns/n_toolcalls/n_total_tokens/latencyを含める。
Anthropic統計手法: SEM報告、clustered SE（naiveの3倍超になり得る）、質問内resampling、paired-difference（frontier間相関0.3–0.7）、power analysis。
OpenAI: SWE-Bench Pro公開731 taskの監査で約30%がbroken（overly strict test / vague requirement / shallow task / misleading description）、推奨撤回。aggregate scoreだけでは信号と雑音を分離できない（fetchは403、検索結果とGigazine等の要約で確認）。
trajectory/tool/artifact/graderのsample監査でreward hacking・invalid passを検出（evidence-supported, high）。

ai-development-improvement (org-private, reputation unknown): read references/evaluation-policy.md ("Adaptive trials") and scripts/plan_evaluation_trials.py: one trial per cell first, a confirmation trial for any decisive cell (candidate flips a baseline failure, margin <= narrow_margin, partial verdicts, guardrail hit), at least 3 trials for R2+ changes, and more trials while the last two disagree, up to max_trials; the same policy requires capturing trajectory (commands, tool calls, time, tokens, retries) and blind/source-hidden review, and record_evaluation.py stores trial_plan/trials/artifacts.

applies_when: model・prompt・Skill・harnessの採用/変更判断を数値で行う
自Repositoryの代表taskでagentを比較する
flakyな結果で原因切り分けを行う
not_applicable_when: 1回きりの探索的作業で判断が結果に依存しない
trialを複数回すtoken予算がない（→サンプル数を減らしても複数runの原則は維持）

expected_effect.primary: 単発runの偶然を判断から除き、変動幅（信頼区間）つきで差を読めるようにする
metrics: n_turns, n_toolcalls, tokens, latency per trial

risks: grader/oracle自体の腐敗を見落とすとk回でも誤判断（→transcript監査必須）
cost: trial数×task数のtoken費用と、transcript読解の人手
known_failure_modes: aggregate scoreだけで採否判断（OpenAI監査: 約30% broken task）
1 runでの'改善した/悪化した'判断
two-sample比較（paired差分より分散が大きい）

matched_on: multiple trials per eval cell instead of a single run
sequential confirmation until two consecutive trials agree
trajectory/transcript capture and independent blind review before a promotion decision
baseline vs candidate compared against written thresholds
